title: Baked Canadian King Prawns
description: A simple and flavorful recipe for Canadian king prawns, baked to perfection in the oven with garlic and herbs. This dish is perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: Rinse the prawns and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, lemon juice, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Toss the prawns with the garlic-lemon mixture until they are well coated.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil, leaving a little room between each prawn.
Arrange the prawns on the prepared baking sheet and drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Sprinkle the prawns with salt, black pepper, and white pepper.
Bake the prawns in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until they turn pink and are cooked through.
Remove the prawns from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley if desired.
Serve the prawns hot and enjoy!
